Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODSession

SetClipboard

The SetClipboard method replaces the clipboard object for this session. 
void SetClipboard (in ODClipboard clipboard);
clipboard
A reference to the new clipboard object for this session.
DISCUSSION
This method may be called only by a shell plug-in's ODShellPluginInstall function.

SEE ALSO
The ODClipboard class (page 83).
The ODShellPluginInstall function (page 952).
